response.sql:
WITH filtered_records AS (
  SELECT team_id, CAST(l AS NUMERIC) / g AS loss_ratio
  FROM manager_half
  WHERE g > 53
),
team_averages AS (
  SELECT team_id, AVG(loss_ratio) AS avg_loss_ratio
  FROM filtered_records
  GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_loss_ratio)
FROM team_averages

assumptions.assumption: The phrase 'average of losses divided by games managed' is interpreted as the average of the ratio (l/g), not the ratio of aggregates (SUM(l)/SUM(g))

alternatives.interpretation: Compute each team's total losses divided by total games managed, then average those ratios across teams
alternatives.sql:
WITH filtered_records AS (
  SELECT team_id, l, g
  FROM manager_half
  WHERE g > 53
),
team_totals AS (
  SELECT team_id, CAST(SUM(l) AS NUMERIC) / SUM(g) AS loss_ratio
  FROM filtered_records
  GROUP BY team_id
)
SELECT AVG(loss_ratio)
FROM team_totals
